candidates.explanation: JwtStrategy verifies access tokens with 'auth.refreshSecret', but access tokens are signed in AuthService.getTokensData with 'auth.secret'. Signature verification always fails, so every protected request with a valid fresh access token gets 401. Login and refresh still work because the refresh strategy correctly uses the refresh secret.

fix.description: Use the access-token secret: configService.getOrThrow('auth.secret', { infer: true }).
